0022600129.text: The Knicks (0-3, 12th in the East) host the Pistons (2-0, 1st in the East) looking to end a three-game losing streak, with New York still winless at home at 0-2. Detroit is without Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision, while New York is missing Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Knicks lost all three meetings in the 2025-26 season series, most recently 126-111 in New York on February 19, 2026.
